skill.name: unknowns-first-engineering
skill.intent: Increase correctness of non-trivial software engineering by inspecting the actual repository, resolving material uncertainty before irreversible work, choosing the smallest risk-appropriate action, and verifying outcomes with evidence.
inputs: relevant code, configuration, tests, schemas, logs, runtime state, or authoritative documentation
outputs: evidence-grounded explanation, exploration, plan, implementation, review, or verification report
exclusions: obvious one-line or local edits without material risk

mechanism.evidence_boundary: A check is passed only if it actually ran; unavailable evidence remains explicitly unverified.
mechanism.permission_boundary: Destructive, shared-state, production, persistent-data, billing, deployment, and public-contract actions require explicit approval unless durably authorized.

portability.host_assumptions: none; adapters translate capability names and workflows
